task_instance: Synthesize 8 mock user interview transcripts (plus a small support-ticket sample) from a 'TaskFlow' onboarding usability study into a full research synthesis document following the skill's required template: executive summary, key themes with prevalence and quoted evidence, insights-to-opportunities table, user segments, prioritized recommendations, open questions, and methodology notes.
evidence: Created interviews.md (8 interview excerpts + 4 support-ticket theme counts) as sample raw research data in the work directory. Produced synthesis.md following the skill's exact output template (Executive Summary, 4 Key Themes each with Prevalence/Summary/Supporting Evidence quotes/Implication, Insights->Opportunities table, User Segments table, 3 prioritized Recommendations, Questions for Further Research, Methodology Notes). Verified the deliverable is grounded in the source rather than fabricated by grepping interviews.md for each theme's keywords (invite/billing, template, workspace/tour, pricing/trial/billing) and cross-checking that the prevalence counts cited in synthesis.md (e.g. 'Theme 1: 6 of 8 participants', 'Theme 4: 4 of 8 participants, 14 support tickets') and every quoted line match actual lines in interviews.md verbatim. Files produced: interviews.md (49 lines), synthesis.md (73 lines) in the work directory. No connectors, credentials, or external services were needed or used; the task was accomplished entirely with local file read/write and text analysis, matching the skill's core deliverable (turning research notes into a structured synthesis doc).
